requirements.text: Page renders visibly with the title, the scenario list, and the output/status region matching the UWP golden; controls present in UIA tree; actions behave as in UWP.
requirements.reason: App builds, launches, and constructs a complete/correct UIA tree (Compare-Parity 4/4 structural), but the window renders VISUALLY BLANK — only caption buttons paint, client area is solid white. Confirmed by winapp screenshot (11KB) and PrintWindow PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT (5.7KB) vs UWP 145KB.
requirements.suspected_skill_gap: The scaffold's <Window.SystemBackdrop><MicaBackdrop/> was kept. A SystemBackdrop composites content through DWM so screenshot/PrintWindow capture returns a blank frame; the UWP used an opaque background with no backdrop. The migration skill is silent on removing the scaffold backdrop / ensuring an opaque, capturable background.

visual_discrepancies.uwp: Full content: title, 13-item scenario ListBox (selected item 1), output paragraph, Microsoft logo, Trademarks/Privacy footer (145KB).
visual_discrepancies.winui: Solid white client area, only caption buttons (11KB winapp; 5.7KB PrintWindow blank).

summary: Structurally perfect migration sunk by a single generalizable defect: the scaffold MicaBackdrop makes the window content non-capturable and diverges from the UWP's opaque background, producing a blank-render visual-parity fail.
